name: Infura
tagline: Ethereum and multi-chain Web3 API infrastructure for dapps and wallets
description: Infura provides hosted JSON-RPC and WebSocket access to Ethereum and other networks, plus IPFS, so developers can read chain state, send transactions, and subscribe to events without running their own nodes.

auth.details: API key (project ID) in the path as https://<network>.infura.io/v3/YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve signup at Infura dashboard

use_cases: get latest Ethereum block number via JSON-RPC
read ERC-20 token balances on mainnet
send signed transactions without running a node
subscribe to pending transactions over WebSocket
